candidates.title: Delay Sign-In After Pet Creation
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to after adoption certificate creation so users form an emotional attachment to their pet before signing up.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early and takes a mean time of 567s. Letting users create their pet first builds motivation to sign in.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet adoption is explicitly allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Delaying friction step builds emotional attachment before sign-in.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Selection Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual stage layout with interactive pet choice cards and personality badges.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a long median time of 89s and mean time of 1017s.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen is allowed as long as it still lets the user choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Targeted redesign for step with the largest user drop (39.1%).

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Interactive Guide
candidates.change: Insert a new onboarding screen before home intro showing users key desktop shortcuts to summon, hide, and talk to their pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple emails about confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Interact With Your Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Learn quick hotkeys and mouse actions to hide, move, or talk to your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new interactive guide screen before home intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop and strong support feedback, but requires a new screen.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Quick-Start Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Replace photo upload with instant pre-generated pet personality templates to prevent creation failures.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and photo upload contributes to the 1017s mean adoption time.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Account Restores & Sync Hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users how to log back into existing accounts to preserve saved pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account method to keep your existing pets and progress intact.

guard.reason: Adding sign-in hints regarding existing accounts is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost fix directly addressing the top support complaint category.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Status & Diagnostics
candidates.change: Show progress and desktop rendering status updates on the waiting screen so users know their pet is initializing.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time has a median of 201s / mean 2336s, and support had 3 reports of pets failing to show up on desktop.

waiting.headline: Summoning your pet to desktop...
waiting.body: Rendering pet graphics and configuring desktop overlay permissions.

guard.reason: Adding progress updates and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Fixes extreme wait times and technical confusion reported in support.

candidates.title: Onboarding Roadmap Checklist
candidates.change: Change choose_path layout to a checklist displaying the step counter and progress track.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s; presenting a structured checklist sets clear expectations for remaining steps.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path layout with progress tracking is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Improves expectations for first step with high mean duration.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Controls Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add a tip carousel to the home intro screen providing actionable tips on controlling desktop pet behaviors.
candidates.why: Support noted multiple post-onboarding confusion emails regarding controlling and hiding desktop pets.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to access commands, hide, or settings.

guard.reason: Adding interactive tips to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Reduces control confusion backed by support mail and finish step drop.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge Reward
candidates.change: Add a celebratory official companion badge and preview component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 60.9%; rewarding users at certification increases completion drive.

guard.reason: Replaces or omits the required official stamp on the adoption certificate.

candidates.title: Account Privacy & Deletion Notice
candidates.change: Include a body notice on the sign-in screen reassuring users about data privacy and easy account deletion options.
candidates.why: Support received 4 emails requesting account or personal data deletion post-onboarding.

sign_in.body: Your privacy matters. Account data is securely encrypted, and you can export or delete your data at any time from settings.

guard.reason: Adding privacy and data management notices to the sign-in screen is compliant with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Easy copy change addressing privacy concerns raised in support.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
